vo_ri_body_mandorla_1.evidence: Native whole frame shows the upper cusp but the lower convergence sits behind the boots and cannot be read as a complete visible lower point; occluded required evidence fails.

vo_ri_body_mandorla_2.evidence: The performer’s boot toes and soles extend below the point where the two almond sides converge; the entire figure is not contained within that enclosure.

vo_ri_body_mandorla_3.evidence: A small gold circular disk surrounds only the head, while a separate much larger pointed light perimeter runs around the standing body.

vo_ri_daoist_robe_xuanwu_1.evidence: A clearly recognizable gold tortoise shell and head occupy one rectangular embroidered chest panel on the performer’s blue robe.

vo_ri_daoist_robe_xuanwu_2.evidence: One silver snake with a visible head and continuous coil crosses and curls around that same gold tortoise shell.

vo_ri_daoist_robe_xuanwu_3.evidence: Reflective stitch texture and the flat bordered blue-cloth panel carry both animal forms; they are textile decoration on the worn robe.

embodiment_body_ownership.evidence: Two hands emerge from the same performer’s sleeves and grip corresponding side seams; the chest animals are cloth motifs rather than additional body parts.

embodiment_joint_chain_and_reach.evidence: Both arm chains bend naturally toward the adjacent hip-height robe seams, with wrists and hands joined coherently to their forearms.

embodiment_support_and_balance.evidence: Both embroidered boots rest on the dry platform under a stable upright torso, with visible shoe-ground contact.

embodiment_contact_and_space.evidence: Each hand visibly pinches blue fabric near the side seam. The broad center panel stays exposed between the grips and the luminous frames lie behind the body.

embodiment_visibility_and_projection.evidence: The seam grips and chest relation are readable, but the final reviewed full-figure projection hides the critical lower almond point behind the boots and leaves soles outside the intended enclosure.

supplemental.whole_image_impression: A poised contemporary robe portrait with a convincing stitched chest emblem and nested luminous framing. The strong central face and textile hierarchy are attractive in context; the too-low shoe placement defeats complete mandorla containment.
supplemental.reference_scope: Visible bob, fringe, eye and face appearance were used as art direction; no identity-match, actual-age, personality, religion, consent or body-shape assessment.
